violations.title: Food Protection Manager - Accredited Program
violations.observation: A certified food manager was not present at the beginning of the inspection.
violations.corrective_action: Obtain a certified food managers certificate from an accredited program. A CERTIFIED FOOD MANAGER ARRIVED DURING THE INSPECTION. A CERTIFIED FOOD MANAGER MUST BE PRESENT AT ALL HOURS OF FOOD PREPARATION AND HANDLING.

violations.title: Hot Holding
violations.observation: The following food item(s) were observed hot holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: 1) white rice on the service line was observed at 102f 2) brown rice on the service line was observed at 98f
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature conrol for safety food shall be held hot at a temperature of 135F or above unless the permit holder is using 'time as the public health control' as specified under 3-501.19. PIC DISCARDED THE RICE.

out_items.name: Contamination prevented during food preparation, storage, and display

violations.title: Food Storage 6 inches above Floor
violations.observation: Observed a box of mayonnaise and a sack of onions being stored on the floor of the kitchen
violations.corrective_action: Food shall be protected from contamination by storing the food at least 6 inches off the floor on approved shelving units or dunnage racks. Milk crates, soda crates, or bread racks are not suitable for food storage. STAFF ELEVATED THE FOOD OFF OF THE FLOOR DURING THE INSPECTION.

out_items.name: Food and non-food contact surfaces cleanable, properly designed, constructed, and used

violations.title: Equipment, Maintain in Good Repair/Condition
violations.observation: The following equipment is not operating properly and/or is in poor repair: 1) gaskets of the two prep coolers were observed broken
violations.corrective_action: Equipment shall be maintained in a state of repair and condition that meets the requirements specified under Parts 4-1 and 4-2. REPLACE GASKETS

violations.title: Separation of Raw Animal and RTE Foods
violations.observation: Observed Raw salmon being stored above a large bowl of avocados in the 2DR under counter cooler.
violations.corrective_action: Food shall be protected from cross contamination by separating raw animal foods like poultry, beef, pork, seafood, and eggs from cooked foods, ready-to- eat foods, washed produce, etc during storage, preparation, holding or display. Raw foods shall be stored on shelving units BELOW or SEPARATED from all cooked foods, commercially processed foods, washed produce, leftover foods, etc. PIC MOVED THE BOWL OF AVOCADOS TO THE TOP SHELF AND PUT THE RAW SALMON ON THE BOTTOM.

violations.title: Cold Holding
violations.observation: The following food item(s) were observed cold holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: 1) In the 2DR prep top cooler for mixings; mixed greens (66f), cut romaine (61f), imitation crab (46f-49f), masago (51f). Upon discussion with PIC, food in this cooler was put out within 1 hour of arrival; 2) in the 2DR prep top cooler for proteins; Raw salmon (46-48f), Raw tuna (43f-46f), tamago (46f). Upon discussion with PIC, food in this cooler was put out 3 hours prior.
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety food shall be held cold at a temperature of 41F or below unless the permit holder is using 'time as public health control as specified under section 3-501.19 to limit bacteria growth. EHS INSTRUCTED PIC TO MOVE ALL OF THE FOOD FROM THE MIXINGS COOLER TO A WORKING COOLER. EHS INSTRUCTED PIC TO DISCARD THE PROTEINS IN 1 HOUR. PIC MOVED THE FOOD TO THE COOLER BEHIND THE COLD LINE. PIC WILL DISCARD PROTEINS AFTER 1 HOURS.

violations.title: RTE TCS Food Prepared On Site, Date Marking
violations.observation: The following refrigerated, ready-to-eat, time/temperature control for safety food that is prepared on site is not used or discarded within 24 hours of preparation and was not observed to be date marked: traditional soy sauce, mild kick sauce, sweet and mild sauce, hot sauce, sweet and hot sauce in the 2DR upright were not labeled
violations.corrective_action: Refrigerated, ready-to-eat, time/temperature control for safety foods that are prepared on site and kept for more than 24 hours cannot have a shelf-life of more than 7 days, including the day of preparation. These food items must be marked with either the 'consume-by' date and/or 'preparation' date, color-coded labels, or another marking system/method that effectively indicates shelf-life that is clearly understood and properly used by the employees. PIC LABELED THE SAUCES.

violations.observation: Observed cases of soda and boxes of take out containers being stored directly on the floor
violations.corrective_action: Food shall be protected from contamination by storing the food at least 6 inches off the floor on approved shelving units or dunnage racks. Milk crates, soda crates, or bread racks are not suitable for food storage. ELEVATE THE FOOD OFF OF THE FLOOR. PLEASE PURCHASE NSF APPROVED SHELVING OR DUNNAGE RACKS. violations.title: Equipment, Maintain in Good Repair/Condition
violations.observation: The following refrigeration unit is not operating properly and is unable to maintain cold food at or below 41F: 1) 2DR prep top cooler for mixings was observed at 60f; 2) 2DR prep top cooler for proteins was observed at 48f
violations.corrective_action: Repair/adjust the unit so it is able to maintain foods at or below 41F. Do not use the unit to store time/temperature control for safety foods while it is not operating properly. OWNERSHIP CALLED SERVICE TECHNICIAN TO REPAIR COOLER.

violations.title: Food Manager Certificate & Responsibility
violations.observation: There is no Certified Food Manager present in the establishment. NO CFM present during inspection
violations.corrective_action: It shall be unlawful to operate a food establishment unless it is under the immediate control of a certified food manager. It is highly suggested that you have more than one employee with the food manager's license. ORS Interactive, Inc. (see handout provided) issues the required photo identification card with proof of successful completion of a certified food manager's exam. Failure to have a certified food manager on site during ALL hours of operation including food preparation, food service, and cleaning/sanitizing of equipment/utensils will result in closure of the establishment. EHS will follow up in 10 calendar days to verify CFM is present during operating hours

out_items.name: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible

violations.title: Handwashing Sink, Water Temp
violations.observation: The handwashing sink at @LOCATION@ is equipped with separate cold and hot water faucets rather than a mixing valve or combination faucet. EHS observed handsink in the kitchen area did have an adequate supply of hot water
violations.corrective_action: A handwashing sink shall be equipped to provide water at a temperature of at least 100F through a mixing valve or combination faucet. EHS spoke to PIC about issue, PIC agreed to have it fixed. EHS will follow up in 10 calendar days to verify compliance.

violations.title: Proper Thawing Methods for ROP Fish
violations.observation: EHS observed ROP tuna, salmon, shrimp and imitation crab being thawed without openings in the packages.
violations.corrective_action: PIC cut holes in packages for the fish, EHS explained criteria for ROP thawing POKEHUB (Inspection Date: 12/23/2024) Page 2 of 3

violations.title: In-Use Utensils Proper Storage
violations.observation: Dispensing and/or in-use utensils improperly stored between use as follows: EHS observed knives being stored in a bucket of sanitizer during inspection
violations.corrective_action: During pauses in food preparation or dispensing, food utensils shall be stored in one of the following manners: 1) in the food with their handles above the top of the food and the container, 2) in food that is not time/temperature control for safety (TCS) food with their handles above the top of the food within containers or equipment that can be closed, 3) on a clean portion of the food preparation table or cooking equipment only if the in-use utensil and the food contact surface of the food preparation table or cooking equipment are cleaned and sanitized, 4) in running water of sufficient velocity to flush particulates to the drain, 5) in a clean, protected location if the utensils are used only with a food that is NOT TCS food, or 6) in a container of water if the water is maintained at a temperature of at least 135F and the container is cleaned frequently. PIC removed knife from sanitizer, instructed employees to not store knives in sanitizer anymore. U
